title: The Martins' Session
content: The Martins expressed concerns about their communication breakdown. They feel unheard and are considering separation. We explored their communication patterns and discovered underlying issues related to trust and past traumas. We agreed to meet next week to continue our discussion and explore potential solutions.

title: Relationship Harmony Workshop Notes
content: Attended a workshop by the Relationship Harmony Institute. Key takeaways: Active listening exercises, 'Two Chairs' communication technique, and the importance of setting boundaries. These strategies can be integrated into couple counseling sessions to facilitate better understanding and conflict resolution.
